home.heroDescription: Web developer, design-minded problem solver, and occasional travel writer. I turn complex ideas into digital experiences that feel clear and human.

home.principle1: Think in systems, not just screens.
home.principle2: Make it useful before making it clever.
home.journalDescription: Stories about travel, making things, and the useful surprises found along the way.

about.metaDescription: About the developer behind the work and the journal.
about.title: A developer who cares about the space between function and feeling.
about.lead: I build web experiences that are useful, inclusive, and enjoyable to spend time with.
about.paragraph1: I enjoy working across design and engineering: shaping an idea, finding the simplest system behind it, and carrying the details all the way into production.
about.paragraph2: When I'm not at my desk, I'm usually walking through a new city, looking for good food, or writing down the small moments I don't want to forget.
about.aiDisclosure: This site is built with AI assistance —

projects.title: Work shaped by curiosity, clarity, and care.

contact.description: Have a project, an opportunity, or just a good idea? Send me a note. I'll get back to you as soon as I can.

pdfToolPage.metaDescription: Compare progress metrics from multiple SE2026 PDF reports in your browser.
pdfToolPage.title: See the numbers move.
pdfToolPage.description: Compare PML supervisors, PCL field workers, or the whole report across multiple progress PDFs—without sending the files anywhere.

pdfTool.uploadDescription: Select two or more reports to see how a person's numbers change between report dates.
pdfTool.localNote: Files stay in this browser and are never uploaded or saved.
pdfTool.errorsTitle: Some files could not be read.
pdfTool.chartAria: over time. Focus or point at a data point for details.
pdfTool.missingDays: day(s) could not be interpolated because there is no actual value on both sides.
pdfTool.forecastPrompt: Choose a future forecast date to calculate the pace needed to reach this target.
pdfTool.insufficientForecast: At least two actual values are needed to compare a forecast with the target.
pdfTool.forecastDisclaimer: Linear estimate based on all actual report values. This is not a guarantee.
pdfTool.behindAction: To reach the target, average {required} per day from the latest actual report—{additional} more per day than the current forecasted trend.
pdfTool.aheadAction: At the current forecasted trend, the target should be exceeded by {difference}. The minimum pace needed from the latest actual report is {required} per day.
pdfTool.metAction: The current forecast is aligned with the target. Maintain approximately {required} per day from the latest actual report.
pdfTool.waitingDescription: The chart will appear here after you select PDF files.
pdfTool.supportedMetrics: Missing days are linearly interpolated only when actual values exist on both sides. Choose a future date to extend a linear regression based on all uploaded reports.
pdfTool.jmlSubmitNote: The default Jml Submit (Real) maps to Real in the older report format.
pdfTool.unsupportedReport: This PDF is not a supported SE2026 progress report.
pdfTool.dateNotFound: The report date could not be found.
pdfTool.monthNotRecognized: The report month is not recognized.
pdfTool.pmlRowsMissing: No supervisor (PML) rows could be read.
pdfTool.pclRowsMissing: No field worker (PCL) rows could be read.
pdfTool.pclRowsPartial: Read {count} PCL rows; the report may contain more.

errors.title: We hit an unexpected detour.
errors.description: Try the page again. If the problem continues, come back a little later.
errors.notFoundDescription: The page may have moved, or perhaps it was never on the map.

dailyQuestions.toolDescription: One question a day, answered privately, then revealed to each other.
dailyQuestions.metaDescription: One question a day for you and your people. Everyone answers privately, and every answer unlocks the moment you write your own.
dailyQuestions.title: One question a day, answered before you look.
dailyQuestions.description: A small shared ritual. A room code instead of accounts, one question per UTC day, and answers that stay sealed until you have written your own. Come back tomorrow.
dailyQuestions.privacyNote: Private by design — nobody's words reach your browser until you have answered
dailyQuestions.step1Text: You get a code and a link. There is no sign-up and nothing to verify.
dailyQuestions.step2Text: Whoever opens it picks a display name and is in. Their device remembers them for a year.
dailyQuestions.step3Text: Write your answer first. The moment you submit it, everyone else's opens for you.

createRoom.title: Start a room
createRoom.description: You will get a code and a link. Sending it to someone is the whole invite.
createRoom.modeHelp: You can change this later, and it applies from the next question.

mode.mixedHint: Knowledge on weekdays, open-ended at the weekend.
mode.knowledgeHint: A question with a verified answer every day, revealed once you have answered.
mode.reflectiveHint: A personal question every day. No right answer, nothing to look up.

joinRoom.title: Join a room
joinRoom.description: Paste the code you were given, or just open the link.

dailyQuestions.codeHint: Codes are 12 characters and never contain I, L, O, U, 0 or 1.

room.inviteHelp: Anyone with this link joins this room. There are no accounts, so treat it like a house key.
room.copyFailed: Copy failed — select the link and copy it manually.
room.noQuestionHelp: The generator was unavailable and the standby question could not be recorded. Try again in a moment.
room.sourceFallback: Hand-checked standby question — the generator was unavailable today.
room.answerPlaceholder: Take your time. You cannot edit this once you submit.
room.lockedHelp: It became final the moment you submitted it. Retract it if you want to start over.
room.settingsHelp: Changing the style takes effect from the next question.
room.leaveConfirm: Leave this room? Your answers stay in the archive for the others.
room.deleteRoomConfirm: Delete this room for everyone? This cannot be undone.
room.retractConfirm: Retract your answer? Everyone else's answers lock again until you write a new one.
room.missedDay: You did not answer this day, so their answers stay sealed.
room.flagNotePlaceholder: The answer is out of date, or the question is ambiguous…
room.flagConfirm: Flag this question? Future questions will avoid this subject. Today's question stays as it is, because someone may already have answered it.
room.questionFlagged: Flagged. Future questions will avoid this subject.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.description: Every day this room has existed. Open a day to read it again.

archive.metaDescription: Every daily question this Lab experiment has asked, one page per day, with the verified answer for knowledge days.
archive.title: Every question so far.
archive.description: The public half of the ritual. Questions and answers are open; nobody's personal answer ever is.
archive.empty: No questions recorded yet. The first one lands at 00:00 UTC.

today.metaDescription: The question the Daily Questions rooms are answering today.
today.title: Today's question.
today.description: Everyone in every room sees this one today. Answers are private; you only read someone else's once you have written your own.
today.empty: Today's question is not ready yet. It appears at 00:00 UTC.

errors.notConfigured: This tool is not configured on this deployment yet.
errors.invalidInput: Please check the form and try again.
errors.nameTaken: That name is already used in this room. Pick another, or open the invite link on the device that already joined.
errors.alreadyInRoom: This device is already in a room. Leave it first, or use a different browser.
errors.roomNotFound: No room has that code. Check it and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts from this connection. Try again later.
errors.unavailable: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.notInRoom: You are not in a room on this device.
errors.invalidAnswer: Write something first — between 1 and 2000 characters.
errors.notToday: That question is no longer open.
errors.questionChanged: The room's question style changed, so today's question is different now. Reload the page.
errors.ownAnswer: You cannot react to your own answer.

notices.answerLocked: Locked. Their answers are open to you now.
notices.modeChanged: Question style updated. It applies from the next question.

status.metaDescription: Live health checks for the Daily Questions tool: the database, the question generator, and whether today's questions were actually generated.
status.title: Is the tool working?
status.description: Live checks on the two things the daily questions depend on, plus whether today's questions exist yet. The usual failure is quiet: the tool keeps working, but serves a standby question instead of a generated one. That shows up here.

detail.notConfigured: Not configured, so every question comes from the standby bank
detail.notGenerated: Not generated yet. The first visit of the day creates it.
detail.standby: From the standby bank, generation failed

status.note: Public but deliberately not indexed. Error text is never shown, only whether each dependency answered.

notify.title: Nudges
notify.description: A notification when the day's question is ready, or when the other person has answered. Your browser talks to its own push service, and the question text is never included — the nudge says only that there is something to read.
notify.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings, then try again.
notify.unsupported: This browser cannot receive them. On an iPhone or iPad, add this site to your Home Screen first, then come back.
notify.failed: Could not turn notifications on. Try again.

travel.metaDescription: Every place in the journal, on one map — gathered from the destinations behind the posts.
travel.title: Where I have been.
travel.description: Every place that has a post behind it, plotted. The journal is written place by place, so this is less a scoreboard than an index.
travel.mapLabel: Map of the places written about in the journal
travel.empty: No destinations have coordinates yet. Add them to a destination in the Studio and they will appear here.

parityTool.metaDescription: Compare two translation JSON files and see exactly which keys have drifted apart. Runs entirely in your browser.
parityTool.title: Two dictionary files. Which keys drifted?
parityTool.description: Paste or open two translation files and get the key paths that exist on one side only, plus any key left blank. Nothing is uploaded — both files are read in this tab.
parityTool.pastePlaceholder: Paste JSON here, or choose a file above
parityTool.allMatch: Exact parity — every key matches on both sides.
parityTool.errorEmpty: This side is empty — choose a file or paste some JSON.
parityTool.errorNotObject: Expected a JSON object at the top level, not an array or a bare value.
parityTool.localNote: Runs in your browser. Neither file leaves this tab.
